Play here, right now

Plain truth: this game runs only in your browser. It does not train Lloyd, and nobody earns any +1s here. The chat game (button above) is the one that teaches him.

How it works

  • You keep 5 cards in hand: at the start of your turn, draw up to 5.
  • Play an animal, then each animal on your field attacks once — or holds back.
  • An attack deals the attacker's ATK as damage. The defender does not hit back.
  • Lose 5 animals and you lose the match. Lloyd gets a +1 every time he wins.
  • Trap cards (bear trap, pepper spray) sit face-down, block an attack and kill the attacker.
  • Remove-trap cards destroy a face-down trap. Vet cards heal 4 HP, but a vet must sit on the field one full round first.
  • No animal in your hand or on the field? Take the animal nearest the top of your deck and put it straight on the field. The rest of the deck stays in order.

After the match

Lloyd asks what he learned — game rules and real-world questions. Every answer he gets right on the first try earns him a +1 too. Wrong picks show him a trap card and he tries again. Nothing is scripted: every match is played for real, and Lloyd's notebook remembers every pick.
